newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Glengarry says test show gold prospect.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Glengarry says test show gold prospect.

text.p: Glengarry Resources NL said on Wednesday exploration work indicates the potential for gold prospects exists at two properties in north Queensland state.
At the Great Britain prospect, significant results returned included 45 metres at 1.0 grams a tonne from nine metres and 14 metres at 2.4 grams/t, the company said.
At Balfes Creek, a high grade intersection to six metres at 13.2 grams a tonne from four metres, including two metres at 36.2 grams/t, was recorded, Glengarry said
Both prospect are located near the Charters Tower gold properties. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
